This '''Jedi''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who trained at the [[Almas Academy]]. He trained alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Kirlocca]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Trained in the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], this Padawan was described black hair, light tan skin, and brown eyes. A wielded a light-blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
